metadata.description: Q34 audit trail extensions for demo-specific events with AtomicHash256 hash chains

overview.purpose: Extend Q34 audit infrastructure for sales demo lifecycle tracking
overview.use-case: 200M document demo with batch progress logging (1M doc intervals)
overview.events: 4 new SecurityEventType variants (DemoTierStarted, DemoTierCompleted, DemoBatchProcessed, DemoVerificationPassed)
overview.performance: 200ns per event (same as core audit logging)

event.name: Demo Tier Started
event.description: Logs when a demo tier (Accuracy/Production/Massive) begins execution
event.frequency: 3 events per full demo (one per tier)

event.name: Demo Tier Completed
event.description: Logs when a demo tier finishes with performance metrics
event.example: Tier: Production | Docs: 1,000,000 | Time: 17.00s | Throughput: 58823.53 docs/sec | Clusters: 42
event.frequency: 3 events per full demo (one per tier)

event.name: Demo Batch Processed
event.description: Logs progress every 1M documents during tier execution

event.name: Demo Verification Passed
event.description: Logs ground truth validation results (Accuracy tier)

function.name: log_demo_tier_started
function.signature: pub fn log_demo_tier_started(tier_name: &str, total_docs: u64, customer_id: &str) -> Result<(), AuditError>

assum.assumption: Tier name is one of Accuracy/Production/Massive

function.name: log_demo_batch_processed
function.signature: pub fn log_demo_batch_processed(batch_num: u64, docs_processed: u64, throughput: f64, customer_id: &str) -> Result<(), AuditError>

assum.assumption: Called every 1M docs (200 events for 200M corpus)

function.name: log_demo_tier_completed
function.signature: pub fn log_demo_tier_completed(tier_name: &str, docs_processed: u64, elapsed_secs: f64, throughput: f64, cluster_count: usize, customer_id: &str) -> Result<(), AuditError>

function.name: log_demo_verification_passed
function.signature: pub fn log_demo_verification_passed(tier_name: &str, precision: f64, recall: f64, f1_score: f64, customer_id: &str) -> Result<(), AuditError>

function.name: verify_demo_audit_chain
function.performance: O(n) sequential verification (BLAKE3 hash per event)

returns.ok-true: Chain valid, all demo events verified

assum.verification: Returns Ok(true) only if every prev_hash matches computed hash

chain-verification.step: 4. Store hash in AtomicHash256 for next event
5. Append to log file (fsync for durability)

performance.verify-chain: O(n) sequential verification 70ns (deserialize + hash + compare) <200m-corpus>14ms total (200 events × 70ns)</200m-corpus>

assumption.verification: Zero mutex/RwLock usage, Relaxed ordering for non-critical reads

assumption.statement: BLAKE3 provides cryptographic tamper detection (2^256 collision resistance)
FixedPointSerialize produces identical bytes for identical events
Tier name is one of Accuracy/Production/Massive
assumption.verification: Caller validates tier_name before calling log_demo_tier_started()

assumption.statement: log_demo_tier_completed() called exactly once per tier
BLAKE3 hash chain provides cryptographic integrity
assumption.verification: verify_demo_audit_chain() returns Ok(true) only if every prev_hash matches

soc2.implementation: BLAKE3 hash chain with AtomicHash256 storage

gdpr.implementation: Complete event logging (tier start/complete, batch progress, verification)

hipaa.implementation: Tamper detection via hash chain verification
